meta.description: EasyTV Partner Console: dashboard, attributed customers, rebates and withdrawals, bonus codes, and promo materials.

auth.title: Partner Console Login
auth.subtitle: Log in with your EasyTV account, the same one you use in the Studio.
auth.networkError: Network error. Please try again later.
auth.loginFail: Verification code is incorrect or expired
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
auth.sameAccountHint: Not a partner yet? Log in to submit a partner application.
auth.ticketInvalid: Access credential is invalid or expired

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Recharges by your attributed customers earn you a rebate, credited to your balance. See your lifetime and monthly performance here.
dashboard.cardWithdrawableSub: Rebates are credited instantly. Request a withdrawal anytime.
dashboard.trendTotals: Period totals: {customers} new customers, {orders} orders, {amount} paid, {rebate} rebate
dashboard.recentEmptyDesc: Share your referral link or referral code with customers. Anyone who signs up with it is attributed to you.

customers.title: Attributed Customers
customers.description: Users who signed up through your referral link / referral code. Nicknames are masked, and only rebate-related summaries are shown.
customers.emptyDesc: Try a different filter, or share your link from the Promo Materials page.

billing.title: Rebates & Withdrawals
billing.description: The rebate from each customer recharge is credited to your balance instantly. Withdrawals are reviewed by the platform before payout.
billing.billsEmptyDesc: Once attributed customers recharge, your rebates will appear here.
billing.withdrawsEmptyDesc: You can request a withdrawal when your balance is above 0.
billing.withdrawDesc: {max} available. Your balance is frozen once submitted, and paid out after approval.
billing.amountExceeds: Cannot exceed the withdrawable balance of {max}
billing.bankNamePh: e.g. China Merchants Bank, Shenzhen Branch
billing.payeeNamePh: Must match the account's real name
billing.withdrawHint: Please double-check the payout details. If the payout fails or is rejected, the amount is returned to your balance.
billing.withdrawSubmitted: Withdrawal request submitted. Please wait for review.

bonusCode.title: Bonus Codes
bonusCode.description: Codes set up for you by operations. Users who redeem one are attributed to you and receive points / first-recharge bonus / membership days. Contact operations if you need a new code.
bonusCode.empty: No bonus codes assigned to you yet
bonusCode.emptyDesc: Bonus codes are created by operations and assigned to a partner. Contact us if you need one.

materials.title: Promo Materials
materials.description: Your referral link, referral code, and ready-made copy. Copy and send to customers.
materials.linkDesc: Anyone who signs up within 30 days of opening your link is attributed to you.
materials.codeHint: Customers who enter your referral code at sign-up are also attributed to you.
materials.rebateHint: For {months} months from attribution, every customer recharge earns this rebate rate.
materials.tplDesc: Includes your referral link and referral code. Copy as is or edit as needed.
materials.tplShort: Make a short drama episode with AI in minutes: {link}
materials.tplGroup:
Recommending EasyTV, an AI video creation platform great for short dramas, product videos, and voiceover videos.
My referral sign-up link: {link} (referral code {code})
Ask me anytime if you have questions.
materials.rule1: Customers who sign up through your link / referral code are attributed to you. Each user can be attributed to only one partner, first come, first served.
materials.rule2: Each recharge by an attributed customer earns a {rate} rebate, credited instantly to your withdrawable balance. If an order is refunded, the matching rebate is reversed.
materials.rule3: Rebates are valid for {months} months from the attribution date. After that, the customer's recharges no longer earn a rebate.
materials.rule4: Self-recharging for rebates, fake orders, and similar violations are prohibited. Violators will have their partner status suspended and rebates clawed back.

settings.title: Profile Settings
settings.description: Manage your contact info and introduction. Name and type are locked after approval. Contact us if you need to change them.
settings.profileDesc: Contact info is visible to the platform only, and is used for settlement and communication.
settings.accountHint: The Partner Console and the Studio share this account. To change your password or linked mobile number, go to Studio settings.

description.apply: MCNs, schools, KOLs, and developers can all apply. Once approved, you get a referral code and earn a rebate on your attributed customers' recharges.
description.pending: We'll review it as soon as possible and notify you in the app once approved. You can edit your details while it's under review.
description.rejected: Please update your details based on the rejection reason and resubmit.
description.disabled: Existing customer attributions are kept, but no new rebates will be earned.

apply.submitted: Application submitted. Please wait for review.
apply.pendingHint: Reviews are usually completed within 1-3 business days.
apply.disabledHint: If you have questions, please contact platform operations.
apply.perk1Desc: Earn a rebate on every recharge by your attributed customers, credited to your balance instantly.
apply.perk2Desc: Customers who sign up via your link or referral code are attributed to you, with a 30-day attribution window.
apply.perk3Desc: Customers, orders, and rebate trends at a glance.
apply.perk4Desc: Supports Alipay / WeChat / bank card, paid out after platform review.
apply.name: Organization / individual name
apply.nameHelp: 2-32 characters. Cannot be changed after approval.
apply.lockedHint: Locked after approval. Contact us if you need to change it.
apply.contactHelp: WeChat / mobile / email all work. Visible to the platform only.
apply.introHelp: Your channels, audience, or past work. This helps speed up approval.
apply.introPh: Briefly describe your channels and audience (optional, up to 500 characters)
